q2_gaps: "not all X is Y" over a MASS / abstract non-count subject — the counterexample-witness rule is stated and exemplified only for count plurals ("Not all swans are white"), so minting a singular witness of an abstract mass noun (sk_eccentricity_1, an instance of eccentricity) has no licence; the mass machinery that does exist (Member + PartOf + ProportionOf) is reserved for "of the" partitives, leaving "some eccentricity is not mental illness" unexpressible
notes: Follows the "Not all swans are white" pattern exactly, with no QuantifierPhrase (correct — "not all" is not the "no/none" case) and no kind-level claim. mental_illness fuses as a term-of-art compound; its genus and the predicable adjectival modifier mental are both required by the compound rule.
